tellings.link_reason: Lazar's firsthand claim of nine craft held at S4, the same as the nine craft seen through the open hangar bay doors.

as_told.title: At least nine craft held in US hangars

plain: Around 1988 or 1989, at S-4, which he describes as a secret site in the Nevada desert, a man named Bob Lazar says he looked down through open hangar bay doors and saw a row of flying craft, nine of them. Lazar tells it as something he saw himself, and in a second telling says "nine for sure," adding that he can only speak to what he saw with his own eyes. If true, it would mean the US government was holding a whole fleet of such craft.
